name: NV Live Visitor Count
author: Nitish Verma

sections.description:
NV Live Visitor Count is a simple, fast, and incredibly accurate solution for tracking real-time traffic and page views on your WordPress website.

Most traditional visitor counters break, freeze, or stop counting entirely when you activate server-side caching or plugins like WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, or Autoptimize. NV Live Visitor Count solves this problem. By leveraging smart asynchronous AJAX technology, it tracks traffic in the background, ensuring every single page view is captured instantly and accurately without affecting your site’s loading speed.

🚀 Key Features

  • Seamless WordPress Integration: Monitor your content performance directly inside your native WordPress dashboard. It automatically adds a sleek “Views” column to your “Posts” and “Pages” management screens.
  • Real-Time Traffic Tracking: Watch your statistics update dynamically as visitors navigate through your pages.
  • 100% Cache Compatible: Works flawlessly alongside all major caching systems and plugins via background AJAX calls.
  • Beautiful Admin Dashboard: Access a modern, clean reporting panel that visualizes “Total Lifetime Views”, “Views Today”, and a curated list of your “Top 10 Most Viewed Pages”.
  • Easy Shortcode Support: Seamlessly display view counts to your front-end users using the simple [nvlvc_views] shortcode anywhere on your posts or pages.
  • Privacy-Focused & Lightweight: Built with performance in mind—no heavy databases or tracking scripts that slow down your server or compromise user privacy.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/nv-live-visitor-count directory, or search for “NV Live Visitor Count” via the WordPress Admin Marketplace.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to your Posts or Pages section to see the real-time view counts immediately!
sections.faq:
Does this plugin impact website loading speed?

Not at all. The plugin runs asynchronously via AJAX in the background, meaning it only triggers after the main page content has loaded for the user.

Is it compatible with Cloudflare and WP Rocket?

Yes! It is specifically engineered to bypass page-level caching from CDNs like Cloudflare and plugins like WP Rocket or LiteSpeed Cache.

Where can I get support or report a bug?

For support, feedback, or feature requests, feel free to contact us at info@nitishverma.com or visit the Official Plugin Page.
